fixed.csv_order: same original copied B file bytes and path in every process

datasets: Unmodified existing 10k A and 10k B company records, positive oracle 7000, ambiguous cohort 2000, known unmatched 1000
configuration: Existing config.template.yaml: top_n20, ann_candidates20, country blocking, unchanged weighted scores and thresholds
cache_control: Reuse first-pass prepared vector/index cache bytes for every run and both campaigns; fresh crossmaps and outputs
execution_order: Shuffle campaign then fixed campaign. Alternate baseline/experiment and experiment/baseline within successive pairs. Sequential subprocesses only.

primary_metric.definition: Mean fraction of B records whose A ID or unmatched state differs between two distinct runs of the same binary
primary_metric.estimator: U-statistic over all unordered within-binary run pairs
primary_metric.effect: baseline minus experimental mean changed-B fraction; positive means more stable experimentally
primary_metric.relative_effect: 100 * effect / baseline changed-B fraction, undefined if baseline fraction is zero
not_primary: number ever varying across all runs

inference.resampling_unit: Whole paired run indices, preserving baseline/experimental pairing; never individual B records or individual pairwise comparisons
inference.sampling: Sample n paired run indices with replacement. Duplicate original index has zero Hamming distance to itself. Use n*(n-1)/2 bootstrap-position pairs as denominator.
inference.interval: Two-sided 95% basic bootstrap: [2*point - q97.5, 2*point - q2.5], linear-interpolated quantiles
inference.interpretation: Intervals excluding zero indicate evidence for a directional change on this corpus/cache/thread setup. No assertion of deterministic complete assignments.
inference.multiple_questions: Separate prespecified shuffled-input and fixed-input questions; no pooled effect and no familywise coverage claim
inference.assumptions: Fresh process run pairs approximately independent/exchangeable conditional on mode and fixed corpus. Frozen ANN cache. Does not establish generalization across corpora, graph builds or thread counts.
inference.optional_stopping: None; run all planned 300 subprocesses regardless of intermediate outcomes

secondary_checks.quality: Paired mean experimental-minus-baseline oracle TP, known-positive wrong A assignments, known-unmatched automatic matches, ambiguous automatic matches, strict precision/recall and count; same whole-pair bootstrap
secondary_checks.oracle_caveat: The strict positive oracle excludes ambiguous B records. Do not interpret every non-oracle pair as a proven identity error.
secondary_checks.performance: All-run wall/RSS summaries and paired wall ratios, including outliers; descriptive, no performance-based exclusions
secondary_checks.integrity: Bijection, active-output totals, identical B bytes within pairs, identical B path across fixed runs, distinct shuffle permutations, cache hits/no encoding, source/input/binary hashes, independent WAL fold to final CSV

source_changes: Benchmark Python/docs only; no Rust implementation changes, commits or merges
